kind: development findings; final-source checks are in checks.json; not Engine-admitted evidence

findings.observed: The latest audit lookup selected generation 9 after publishing generation 10.
findings.cause: ORDER BY resolved a selected ::text alias, giving lexical numeric ordering.
findings.change: Qualify all loader ordering columns and the latest-audit key with their underlying table alias.

findings.observed: Native commit publication returned infrastructure Unavailable before COMMIT.
findings.cause: The outbox event-type parameter inferred a PostgreSQL domain rather than text for the Rust string binding.
findings.change: Bind the event type with an explicit ::text cast.

findings.observed: A deliberate signer mutation failed at its admission foreign key before the loader could inspect it.
findings.change: Retain that database constraint and remove the mutable signer row in the corruption fixture to test missing-link recovery rejection.

findings.observed: A six-second lease fixture expired during normal phase-by-phase reopen.
findings.change: Use a longer initial fixture lease, wait outside the SQL transaction until a short live interval, then cross expiry at the trusted BeforeCommit hook within the existing idle-transaction deadline. Production renewal still cannot shorten a lease.

findings.observed: The first complete serial PostgreSQL run passed 31 of 32 groups; the registration-fault assertion saw the lifecycle-fault snapshot.
findings.cause: Both tests used the literal scope label native-faults within the same process ID.
findings.change: Give the lifecycle fault test its own native-lifecycle-faults label; audit all static and generated scope labels. Preserve the first-pass source manifest/log, and rerun the complete suite.
findings.regression: Run native_sql_faults_roll_back_or_reconcile_exactly_once and sql_registration_rolls_back_failures_and_withholds_lost_commit_acknowledgement in one process; full serial PostgreSQL suite.

policy: No migration ledger, default credential admission, authorization assertion, verification requirement or Engine semantic rule was weakened.
oracle_followup: Expand the independent SQL pair oracle to all 16 combinations of read/write, invariant-scope and predicate attributes, so pure predicate and pure invariant conflicts are exercised separately.

focused_namespace_regression.result: Both formerly colliding groups passed together in one process after scope separation.
